'''Boro-borosa III''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Boro-borosa system/Legends|Boro-borosa system]] with three [[Star/Legends|suns]]. The system was a minor [[House Garonnin|Garonnin]] possession with [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations in three [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belts and the planetary ring. It was rumored to be home to a fabled lost treasure left by [[Hutt Empire|Hutt Royalty]] or the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].

Boro-borosa III's [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] would be sent to the nearby planet of [[Atron]], which was known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for its [[Prison/Legends|prisons]].
